coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 3 of 7 ground-truth items (43%): per-feature standardization equivalent to StandardScaler, configurable ACF lag count, and explicit training/testing splits.
coverage.design_error_analysis: ETTh1 is one of several datasets rather than the fixed dataset throughout. ACF uses a custom FFT implementation instead of statsmodels.tsa.stattools.acf. The primary cycle-selection rule uses prominence and harmonic filtering rather than the highest autocorrelation peak; raw argmax appears only as a baseline or fallback. No ACF-versus-lag visualization is specified among the planned plots. The output adds extensive unrelated forecasting experiments.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground truth.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing both the ACF plot showing periodic peaks and the recommendation for an optimal CycleNet cycle length.
